matter_background.original: By a Final Decree dated 5th May 2018 entered in partition case bearing No 3535/P of the District Court of Nugegoda, Ajith Silva was allotted all that allotment of Land marked Lot 2 depicted in Plan No 1616 dated 2nd March 2010 made by A C Perera Licensed Surveyor of the land called Kahatagahawatte bearing assessment No 12 Temple Road, Nugegoda containing in extent 15 perches. Ajith Silva upon Deed of Gift No 515 dated 10th December 2018 attested by PC Nonis Notary Public gifted the said Lot 2 depicted in said Plan No 1616 to Prabash Silva who is the elder son of Ajith subject to life interest of the Donor and also subject to the condition that Prabash shall not sell, mortgage or otherwise deal with the land but enjoy the produce thereof during his lifetime and that on the death of Prabash the property shall devolve free of all conditions to Subash who is the younger son of Ajith Silva. Ajith had three children namely Prabash, Subash and Shehani by his second marriage to Yamuna. Ajith had another daughter named Kushani from his first marriage to Sumana. Ajith Silva died intestate on 2nd March 2019 and Prabash Silva died intestate on 2nd June 2019 by the Covid 19 Pandemic. Prabash had two daughters namely Sunali and Bimali by his first wife Sheela and two sons namely Brian and Rian by his second wife Linda. Sheela died on 5th August 2019 intestate. Brian married Sara and thereafter died by an accident on 25th September 2021 without having children. Sonali died on 10th October 2023 unmarried and issueless.

matter_background.original: By a final decree dated 25th October 2010, entered in District Court of Pugoda Partition Case No. 582/P the land and premises bearing Assessment No.45, Colombo Road, Púgoda depicted as Lot 1 in Plan No.173 dated 27th February 2009 made by K.D. Silva Licensed Surveyor of the land called Annasiwatta in extent of 38 perches was allotted to one Gamini Jayasinghe. By Deed of Transfer No.2778 dated 10th March 2011 attested by A. Kamala Silva upon Deed of Gift No.5634 dated 18th April 2011 attested by V. Gunatithilaka Notary Public of Gampaha gifted the said land and premises unto her only son Kasun from her ex-husband Thilak: Kamala died on 07th July 2011 leaving her second husband Namal Silva and two children namely Sarathi and Amal. Kasun died on 03rd May 2013 intestate and unmarried and his estate was duly administered in District Court of Pugoda in Testamentary Proceeding No.1589/2013/T. The said proceedings-were terminated on 10th February 2014 and the Administrator's Conveyance No.6231 dated 21st March 2014 attested by V. Gunathilaka Notary Public was executed by Thilak who was the Administrator of the estate of his late son Kasun. Thilak died on 03rd March 2017 intestate. Thilak was previously married to Sumana and had two children namely Sunil and Lalith. On 08th August 2018 Sarathi met with an accident and died interstate and issueless leaving her husband Sena.

matter_background.original: By a final decree dated September 5, 2005, entered in District Court Nugegoda Partition Case No. 371/P, the land and premises bearing Assessment No. 3, Alwis Road, Nugegoda, depicted as Lot A in Plan No. 135 dated March 6, 2004, made by H.D. Perera, a licensed surveyor of the land called Nugagahawatta in an extent of 12 perches, were allotted to one Kanthi Perera. By Deed of Gift No. 1663 dated January 20, 2006, attested by W.D. Anil, Notary Public of Colombo, said Kanthi Perera gifted as an absolute and irrevocable gift the land and premises bearing Assessment No. 3, Alwis Road, Nugegoda, to her eldest son Suneth Perera, subject to the life interest of her and her husband Kamal Perera. Kanthi Perera died on August 18, 2006, leaving her husband Kamal Perera and three children, namely Suneth, Lalani, and Akash. Suneth died on July 01, 2008, intestate and unmarried, and his estate was duly administered in District Court of Nugegoda in Testamentary Case No. 1231/2008/T. The said proceedings were terminated on December 20, 2008, and the Administrator's Conveyance No. 2635 dated December 22, 2008, attested by W.D. Anil, Notary Public, was executed by Kamal Perera, who was the Administrator of the estate of his late son Suneth. Kamal Perera died on January 02, 2012, intestate. Kamal was previously married to Senani and had a child, namely Ravi. On June 04, 2013, Akash met with an accident and died intestate, issueless, leaving his wife Seena. Kanthi was previously married to Sarath and had only one child, Salinga, who was living with her.

matter_background.original: By a final decree dated 21/05/2000, entered in Partition Case bearing No.7268/P of District Court of Nugegoda Kamal Gunatilleke was allotted all that allotment of land marked Lot 1 depicted in Partition Plan No.2372 dated 15/06/1998 made by.A.W. Silva Licensed Surveyor of land called Kandawatta bearing Assessment No.15, Kandawatta Road, Nugegoda containing in extent 14 Perches. He was married to Thilaka Gunatilleke and had 3 children namely Pethum, Kalum and Shanthi. Kamal Gunatilleke upon Deed of Gift No.232 dated 02/08/2002 attested by A.C. Sisira Notary Public gifted said Lot 1 depicted in the said Plan No.2372 unto to the eldest son Pethum as an absolute and irrevocable gift subject to life interest of him and his wife Thilaka. Kamal Gunatilleke died on 07/07/2005. Kamal had two children named Sadun and Nadun by his first wife Kanthi. Pethum died intestate and issueless on 08/06/2010 leaving his wife Sadana. Sadun married to Roshini and died intestate on 02/08/2011 leaving one child named Rohan. Rohan met with an accident and died on 03/10/2018 unmarried and issueless.

matter_background.original: By a Final Decree dated 07.09.1999 entered in the Partition Case bearing No. 516/P of the District Court of Kaduwela, all that allotment land marked Lot 5 depicted in Partition Plan No. 1100 dated 06.05.1997 made by W.P. Gunaratne Licensed Surveyor of the land called Delgahawatta bearing Assessment No. 3A, Sarasavi Lane situated at Battaramulla 30 perches in extent was allotted to one Nihal Gamage. The said Nihal Gamage upon Deed of Gift No. 663 dated 21.11.2002 attested by Athula De Silva Notary Public of Colombo, gifted the said Lot 5 in the said Plan No.1100 unto his son, Piyal Gamage as an absolute and irrevocable gift subject to the life interests of the Donor and his wife Kanthi Gamage. Thereafter, Nihal Gamage died intestate on 28.04.2003 leaving as his intestate legal heirs his wife Kanthi Gamage, his 3 children by their marriage, namely, Piyal, Aruna, Leela and 2 children by his previous marriage to Anusha, namely Nikitha and Rikitha. Piyal Gamage died intestate on 02.08.2006 unmarried and issueless and his estate was administered and letters of Administration was issued to his mother Kanthi Gamage in the District Court of Kaduwela Case No.1052/2006/T. The proceedings were terminated on 27.11.2007. Kanthi Gamage met with an accident and died intestate on 17.03.2010. Rikitha married to Sanatha and died intestate on 02.08.2016 without having children.

matter_background.original: Anura Perera your client wants to purchase a house and property situated in Rajagiriya said to be belonging to one Kusum Peiris and gives you a copy of a Transfer Deed No. 234 dated 23rd March, 2015 attested by Walter de Silva Notary Public and a copy of a Survey Plan No.1125 dated 2nd January, 2000 made by Anil Silva Licensed Surveyor relating to an allotment of land marked Lot B together with a Reservation for a Road marked Lot R of the Land called Dewatagahawatta in extent of 30 perches situated in Rajagiriya. On examining the documents tendered and after a search at the Colombo Land Registry you observe that Lot B and R depicted in the said Survey Plan are sub-divisions of Lot 1 containing in extent of One Rood and 10 Perches depicted in Partition Plan No. 567 dated 4th April 1998 also made by Anil Silva Licensed Surveyor (herein after referred to as the Original land). 1. The Original Land was allotted to one Alfred Almeida by Final Decree in the District Court of Colombo Partition case No. 1256/P and subsequently by Survey Plan 1125 made by Anil Silva Licensed surveyor sub-divided the said Lot 1 into 4 allotments of land marked A,B,C.and R. and by Deed of Transfer No. 234 dated 23rd March 2015 attested by Walter de Silva Notary Public sold Lot B together with undivided 1/3rd share of the Road Reservation marked Lot R to Sunil Peiris. 2. Sunil Peiris had died Intestate without children on 6th December 2016 leaving behind his widow Kusum Peiris. His estate was duly Administered in District Court Testamentary Case No. 345/16/T and proceedings terminated on 7th May 2018.On examining the Testamentary Case it was observed that the father of Sunil Peiris one Charles Peiris had pre-deceased him leaving behind 2 children named Upul and Wimal by his 1st marriage to Kamala Peiris and three children named Sunil, Kanthi and Manel by his 2nd marriage to Pushpa Peiris. Pushpa Peiris was alive and she too had a child by her 1st marriage to Lal Perera named Keerthi Perera and three children named Sunil, Kanthi and Manel by her 2nd marriage to Charles Peiris.

matter_background.original: By a Final Decree dated 3rd September 2006 entered in DC Negambo Partition Action No. 321/P premises No. 3/2 Alwis Town, Hendala depicted as Lot 5 in Plan No. 213 dated 5th March 2006 made by H.S. Weerasena Licensed Surveyor in extent of 36 perches was allotted to one Albert Perera. By Deed of Gift No.675 dated 2nd June 2008 attested by G.N.de Silva Notary Public the said Albert Perera gifted the above Lot 5 in extent of 36 perches to his daughter Kusum Perera. The said Kusum Perera caused the said Lot 5 to be subdivided into. 2 Lots depicted as Lot 5A and 5B (bearing Assessment Nos. 3/2A and 3/2B) in Plan No. 225 dated 3rd June 2009 made by the same surveyor each containing 18 perches and executed a Last will No.980 dated 6th April 2010 attested by G.N.de Silva Notary Public. She died on 23rd May 2012 and her Will was proved in DC Negambo Case No. 456/DTS on 10th March 2013. By the said Last Will she left Lot 5A to her son Gayan Peiris and Lot 5B to her daughter Malika Peiris and an Executors Conveyance was executed by the Executor at the conclusion of the case. In 2014 Gayan Peiris was a minor who was 15 years old and his sister Malika Peiris was 20 years old decided to sell the property to Mrs. Mala Nadaraja and accordingly sold both lots 5A and 5B to her by Deed of Transfer No. 1234 dated 1st August 2014 attested by Alex Perera Notary Public. Mrs. Mala Nadaraja who was governed by the Law of Thesawalamai sold Lot 5A to Nihal & Company by Deed of Transfer 456 dated 3rd February 2015 attested by W.N. de Silva Notary Public .The husband of Mrs. Mala Nadaraja, Moahan Nadaraja was living at that time. After his death Mrs. Mala Nadarja sold lot 5B to Lalith Perera by Deed of Transfer No. 789 dated 5th April 2017 attested by Gamini Peiris Notary Public. The said Lalith Perera died intestate on 2nd March 2018 leaving as his intestate heirs his wife Kamani and two children Hasini and Kushan. The Estate was administered and letters of Administration was issued in DC Colombo Case No. 1579/DTS and an Administrators Conveyance was executed by the Administrator. Kamani was previously married and was having a daughter named Ruvini who was living with her. Kamani gifted her share to all three children.

matter_background.original: By a Final Decree dated 2nd December 1999 entered in DC Colombo Partition case No. 523/P, premises bearing Assessment No. 35, Sarasavi Lane Colombo 3 depicted as Lot 3 in Plan No. 2131 dated 12th June 1998 made by Lal Peiris Licensed Surveyor in extent of 30 perches was allotted to Kanthi Perera. She purchased Lot 2 in extent of 30 perches of the said Plan from her brother Wimal Perera by Deed of Transfer 456 dated 6th February 2000 attested Sarath Wickremasinghe Notary Public Colombo. Kanthi Perera amalgamated the said 2 lots and caused to be subdivided into 3 lots depicted as Lot 1,2 and 3 (bearing Assessment Nos. 35/1, 35/2 and 35/3 respectively) in Plan No.567 dated 10th June 2001 made by the same surveyor each containing in extent 20 perches. Mrs Kanthi Perera gifted Lot 1 thereof to Amali Perera a minor who was 16 years old, her daughter from a previous marriage by Deed of Gift No. 1054 dated 6th February 2005 attested by Jagath Perera Notary Public subject to her life interest. In 2013 she sold this property. Mrs Kanthi Perera died intestate on 1st September 2014. Her estate was administered in DC Colombo case No. 567/T and her husband Kamal De Silva was appointed as Administrator. Proceedings of this case was terminated on 6th November 2015. Kanthi had two children out of her marriage to Kamal De Silva namely Anusha and Anuk. Kamal De silva wrote an Administrators Conveyance on 3rd December 2015 and passed the title of Kanthi Perera's intestate Estate to her heirs. Thereafter he gifted his share of the Estate to his two children. Amali Perea was living with his father and after her marriage to Anura Fernando he passed away. Amali met with an accident after one month of her mothers death and died intestate and issueless.
